svg.title: Skills and tools
svg.desc: Language: Python, Object oriented programming. Backend: FastAPI, REST APIs, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn. AI and LLM: LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, Embeddings, Similarity search, Prompt engineering. Data: PostgreSQL, Neon, ChromaDB, Alembic. Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman, Streamlit, Brevo. A mix of tools used in projects and tools still being learned.
svg.text: A mix of tools I've used in projects and tools I'm still learning.
